text: Two algorithms in the same big-O class will perform about the same.
explanation: Constant factors are exactly what big-O discards, and two O(n log n) sorts can differ tenfold. Big-O also cannot see the memory hierarchy — Chapter 15 measured a threefold difference between row-major and column-major traversal doing identical operation counts, both O(n²) — nor branch prediction, nor what the JIT does. It tells you how a program behaves as the input grows, and nothing else.
